topic: T. rex had a bone-crushing bite
script: T. rex had one of the strongest bites of any land animal ever. Scientists estimate its bite force at about 35,000 to 57,000 newtons. That is many times stronger than a lion's bite. Its biggest teeth were up to about 30 centimeters long, including the root. Fossil T. rex poop contains crushed bone, so it ate bones too. Adults grew to about 12 meters long.
